senses.gloss: m. (cmp. פַּיָיס) [pebble,] name of a species of beans (cmp. כַּרְשִׁינָא I a. III), called in Hebrew sappir.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:1:7">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> top, R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:1">Kil. I, 1</cite> (ed. <cite ref="Q00399"><he>פושונה</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="O01374"><he>סַפִּיר</he></cite>.
